_: Voice-timed cut v3: Explorer beat dropped, wallets 1.5x, no speed tags.

head: Rituals
caption:
Welcome to Rituals. Show up, or pay up…
where you put a stake on a weekly promise.

Fresh wallet, nothing in it. I tap Get test tokens:
50 of them plus a little devnet SOL. Nothing to sign.
Then we start one.

Step one, we name it. Mine's Touch grass.
I decide what counts: two hours outside, phone in pocket.

Step two: how many weeks, and how many tokens.
Two weeks and 20 tokens, an even split.
Any combination up to 16 weeks works.

Next, where the stake goes if you miss a week's check-in.
A few demo options, or a wallet address of your choice.
I pick City Animal Shelter, and lock it in.

Seed Vault Wallet warns it doesn't recognize this domain,
because the APK is sideloaded. Double-tap, fingerprint.
One approval creates it, stakes it and activates it.
note: Seed Vault Wallet · one approval creates, stakes and activates

caption:
Week one opens in 25 seconds.
Demo speed means a week is about a minute and a half.
note: Demo speed · a week here is 1.5 minutes

caption:
I fill in a quick note here
to remember what I did.
note: the note stays on the phone

caption:
Second wallet approval, for the check-in stamp.
Same drill: double-tap, fingerprint. It thinks about it,
says success, and I'm back in the app.
note: Seed Vault Wallet · one approval per stamp

caption:
Second wallet approval, for the check-in stamp.
Same drill: double-tap, fingerprint. It thinks about it,
says success, and I'm back in the app.
note: Seed Vault Wallet · one approval per stamp

caption:
Then confetti. You showed up!
A little fun never hurts.

Week two. The clock's at 3x so you don't have to sit through it.
I'll stamp it later. Wink wink. Totally.

Then the week gets away from me. Toddler this and that,
snack, bath, twelve books for bedtime. The time goes by.

note: the app's settle key closes the week, no approval

caption:
Side by side: KEPT, 10 back to me with my note.
MISSED, 10 to the shelter. Same promise, two outcomes.
But hey, at least it's a good cause.
